Yannis is not a marketer. He is a machine learning scientist who spent years reverse engineering TikTok virality with an engineering mindset, and five years later he built a system that opens 50 to 100 brand new TikTok accounts per week, produces thousands of videos, and generates 10 to 50 million views per month, all without hiring a single creator or influencer. Last year his system drove 300 million views and 3 to 5 million app downloads across his portfolio.

In this episode we walk through his entire playbook step by step. How he does creative research to find viral formats that actually convert to downloads and not just views. The comment bait method and why going viral with the wrong angle gets you millions of views and zero installs. The reposter model and why keeping creative control in-house beats delegating to UGC creators. How he uses tools like Spy Talk to correlate TikTok outlier posts with real app store ranking movements. And why he would validate a format before building the app, not the other way around.

If you are building a consumer app and trying to figure out organic growth, this is one of the most tactical episodes we have done.
